title: ESCOLHENDO MINHA BIKE: SUNPEED GALAXY 2026

takeaways.text: Aluminium frame with carbon fork, sharing the Victory's geometry; 38 mm alloy wheels from SUNPEED's ANV brand, integrated bar with no visible cables, and Shimano 105 12-speed mechanical with hydraulic discs and a 50/34 170 mm crank.
Sizes S to XL; the M measures about a 52 cm top tube, and they steer a 1.75–1.76 m rider to the L (about 54).
Welds are smoothed so the alloy frame looks like carbon, with dropped seatstays and a modern geometry.
On their scale it came in under 10 kg (about 9.5 kg as spoken), lighter than the 12–13 kg they expected of an alloy bike.

disclosure: Road700c is a Brazilian bike marketplace that sells SUNPEED and promotes its own service in the video; Portuguese automatic captions.
summary: A Brazilian marketplace's walkaround and weigh-in of the SUNPEED Galaxy 2026 alloy road bike with Shimano 105 R7120.
